title: 第24章 不淡定的父母
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
宋锦很紧张。

    她以为自己表现的很淡定。

    实际上拿着茶杯的手，都用力握紧了几分。

    李西朋也在忐忑中。

    李西海也没说话，拿出手机点了几下，就放在桌子上，推给李西朋。

    宋锦微微矜持，也俯身看了过去。

    十四个连板涨停。

    290万本金，便是1100万。

    当手机界面出现的那一片红，还有背后一连串的数字。

    宋锦的脸庞升起一股嫣红，心里被数字给狠狠撞击了。

    八百多万的浮盈，1100万总市值。

    无疑不是在刺激着她的美眸。

    就在这个小县城，就在这个江边茶楼，就眼前这个年轻人。

    她记得对方比自己大了2岁而已。

    今年好像还没过25的生日。

    他就在股市中豪取八百万，拥有千万身家。

    还全部都是现金。

    “哥！”

    李西朋涨红了脸，比当事人还激动，“你特么太牛笔了！”

    “卧槽。”

    “我哥是千万富翁。”

    “家族里的人要知道，怕是要集体爆炸。”

    “整个家族群都要炸。”

    李西海微微一笑，端起茶杯呷了一口，“不要传出去，低调点。”

    “哥，你这心态就不对。”

    李西朋有不同的看法，“你又不是三五十岁，二十多点，正是意气风发，血气方刚的时候。”

    “低调？”

    “那不是跟锦衣夜行一样，赚钱再多有毛用啊。”

    “换了是我，早就张扬嚣张起来了。”

    李西海伸手把手机拿过来，关掉界面，道：“你太年轻了。”

    “千把万而已，不至于。”

    李西朋无语道：“而已？”

    “哥，你知道现在二十几岁，不靠家里，就靠自身，能有千万身家的，全国都没几个。”

    宋锦点了点头，撩了一下耳发，露出明媚之色，有点嗔怪道：“西海哥，你这话说的就太打击人了。”

    “我还没工作，吃家里的，你就这么厉害了。”

    “以后还怎么得了啊。”

    李西海笑而不语，心头倒是没什么浮躁得意。

    这才哪里到哪里啊。

    有预知系统。

    千万不过是毛毛雨。

    以后，千万连零头都算不上。

    他心态向来都稳得很，哪怕这次账户突破千万，在他看来也是预料之中，理所应当的。
content_en:
Song Jin was very nervous.

    She thought she was acting calmly.

    In fact, the hand holding the tea cup was clenched a little harder.

    Li Xipeng was also worried.

    Li Xihai didn't say anything. He took out his cell phone and clicked a few times, then put it on the table and pushed it to Li Xipeng.

    Song Jin was slightly reserved and leaned over to look over.

    Fourteen consecutive daily limits.

    2.9 million principal is 11 million.

    When the phone interface appeared, it was red, with a series of numbers behind it.

    Song Jin's face turned bright red, and her heart was hit hard by the numbers.

    A floating profit of more than 8 million yuan and a total market value of 11 million yuan.

    It was definitely not stimulating her beautiful eyes.

    In this small county town, in this riverside teahouse, there is this young man in front of me.

    She remembered that the other person was only 2 years older than her.

    It seems like I haven’t celebrated my 25th birthday yet this year.

    He made eight million in the stock market and has a net worth of tens of millions.

    It's all cash.

    "Brother!"

    Li Xipeng blushed and was even more excited than the person involved, "You are so awesome!"

    "Fuck."

    "My brother is a multimillionaire."

    "If everyone in the family knows about it, they might explode collectively."

    "The whole family group is going to explode."

    Li Xihai smiled slightly, picked up the teacup and took a sip, "Don't spread the word, keep a low profile."

    "Brother, your mentality is wrong."

    Li Xipeng had a different view, "You are not in your thirties or fifties. In your twenties, it is the time when you are full of energy and vitality."

    "Low-key?"

    "It's not like Jin Yi Ye Xing. No matter how much money you make, it's useless."

    "If it were me, I would have become arrogant a long time ago."

    Li Xihai reached for the phone, turned off the interface, and said, "You are too young."

    "It's just a handful, not that big of a deal."

    Li Xipeng said speechlessly: "That's it?"

    "Brother, you know you are in your twenties now. You don't rely on your family, you rely on yourself. There are only a few people in the country who can have a net worth of tens of millions."

    Song Jin nodded, flipped his hair, showed a bright look, and said a little bit angrily: "Brother Xihai, what you said is too shocking."

    "I haven't worked yet, so I eat food from home, and you are so good."

    "How can we get it in the future?"

    Li Xihai smiled and said nothing, but there was no impetuous pride in his heart.

    Where did this go?

    There is a predictive system.

    It's definitely just a drizzle.

    From now on, ten million won’t even count as a fraction.

    His mentality has always been very stable. Even if his account exceeded 10 million this time, he thought it was expected and natural.
title_en: Chapter 24 Parents who are not calm
